versions.subject: Merge PR #4702 from @nasbench - Rule tuning and updates
versions.detection:
selection:
    Initiated: 'true'
    Image|endswith:
        - '\excel.exe'
        - '\outlook.exe'
        - '\powerpnt.exe'
        - '\winword.exe'
        - '\wordview.exe'
filter_main_common_ports:
    DestinationPort:
        - 53 # DNS
        - 80 # HTTP
        - 139 # NETBIOS
        - 443 # HTTPS
        - 445 # SMB
filter_main_outlook_ports:
    Image|contains: ':\Program Files\Microsoft Office\'
    Image|endswith: '\OUTLOOK.EXE'
    DestinationPort:
        - 465 # SMTP
        - 587 # SMTP
        - 993 # IMAP
        - 995 # POP3
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: Initiated="true" Image IN ("*\\excel.exe", "*\\outlook.exe", "*\\powerpnt.exe", "*\\winword.exe", "*\\wordview.exe") NOT (DestinationPort IN (53, 80, 139, 443, 445) OR (Image="*:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office\\*" Image="*\\OUTLOOK.EXE" DestinationPort IN (465, 587, 993, 995)))
